subject: Re: Halcyon RFP — contract questionnaire & order form clarifications
messages:

Cc: Halcyon Systems Procurement <procurement@halcyonsys.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Halcyon RFP - contract questionnaire and order form (attached)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our procurement team attached the formal contract questionnaire and our standard order form for vendors. We have a few points where we need clearer commitments from Redwood before we can move to our legal review:

- Indemnity scope for third-party claims (we flagged sections 4 and 5 in the questionnaire)
- Liability cap: is there flexibility to tie to 12 months of fees instead of the 6 months listed?
- IP: we need clarification on output ownership vs. underlying model weights and derivatives
- Order form: confirmation of billing cadence and termination obligations

I attached Halcyon_RFP_Contract_Questionnaire.pdf and the draft order form. Can you confirm who on your side will own responses and an estimated turnaround?

Best,
Emma Li

Halcyon Systems

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Halcyon RFP - contract questionnaire and order form (attached)

Team — forwarding Halcyon's questionnaire. Key asks: broader indemnity language (third-party claims), increase liability cap to 12 months of fees, clarify output/IP boundaries, and confirm order form billing/termination.

Scope out high-risk items and proposed fallback language we can present. Priorities:
1) Indemnity — can we accept limited indemnity for third-party IP claims tied to Redwood's willful misconduct or breach?
2) Cap — propose sliding cap: 6 months standard, 12 months if they require specific SLA 99.9%+ or enterprise support (reserved capacity) paid for
3) IP — we should preserve customer ownership of generated content but keep model weights and improvement rights (standard SaaS approach)

Please draft redline/response and include short explanation bullets we can send to procurement. Emma asked for a 48–72 hour turnaround.

Thanks — Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Halcyon RFP - contract questionnaire and order form (attached)

Ben / team — see attached draft responses. I answered the questionnaire with a commercial/legal compromise that should be acceptable to a mid-size enterprise:

Highlights (summary for procurement):
- Indemnity: Redwood will indemnify for third-party claims arising from our gross negligence or willful misconduct. For IP infringement claims tied to customer-provided data, we propose an indemnity limited to direct losses and subject to our insurance limits.
- Liability cap: Proposed standard cap = 6 months of fees. If Halcyon requires a 12-month cap, we can agree conditioned on (a) a 12-month committed spend (reserved capacity / Dedicated plan) or (b) purchase of enhanced SLA (99.9% uptime) and premium support. This mirrors our playbook and keeps predictable economics.
- IP & outputs: Customers retain ownership of the outputs they provide and the generated content. Redwood retains rights to model weights and improvements; we commit not to use customer PII for model training without express consent.
- Order form: Confirmed billing cadence = monthly by default; annual prepay available for discounts. Termination for convenience = 30 days with pro rata refund for prepaid services; termination for cause follows standard cure periods.

I've attached: Redwood_Responses_Contract_Questionnaire.pdf and a clean Redwood_OrderForm_Draft_v2.docx. Redlines are in the questionnaire PDF.

On the indemnity point: recommend we offer a narrow additional carveout for claims arising from license violations of open-source components only if we have visibility into the customer's deployment settings (rare for hosted).

Let me know if you want firmer language on caps or if Sales wants to offer a limited concession for the deal.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Responses_Contract_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 18 pages); Redwood_OrderForm_Draft_v2.docx (DOCX)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@halcyonsys.com>

Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Halcyon RFP - contract questionnaire & order form clarifications

Hi Emma — attached is our formal set of responses (Redwood_Responses_Contract_Questionnaire.pdf) and a clean draft of the order form (Redwood_OrderForm_Draft_v2.docx). Summary below to make review quicker:

- Indemnity: Redwood will indemnify Halcyon for third-party claims caused by Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct. For IP infringement claims tied to customer-supplied materials, we propose indemnity limited to direct damages and subject to our insurance cap.

- Liability cap: Our standard is 6 months of fees. If Halcyon requires a 12-month cap we can offer that as a commercial concession in exchange for (i) a 12-month committed reserved capacity contract or (ii) purchase of enhanced SLA/premium support. This keeps unit economics predictable for both parties.

- IP / Outputs: Halcyon retains ownership of content it submits and the content generated for Halcyon. Redwood retains rights to model weights, improvements, and derivative training artifacts. We will not use Halcyon data for model training without explicit consent or contractual terms.

- Order form / billing: Default billing is monthly in arrears. Annual prepay is available at a discount; termination for convenience is 30 days with pro rata refund for unused prepaid term.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which option you'd prefer for the liability cap (standard 6-months or 12-months with commitment).
2) If you want a side call to walk through the redlines, we're available Mon/Tue next week — propose 30 minutes with procurement + legal.
3) If acceptable, we'll convert the order form to a DocuSign packet and send the link.

For transparency, I included a short excerpt of Laura's rationale in the attachment.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: Redwood_Responses_Contract_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 18 pages); Redwood_OrderForm_Draft_v2.docx (DOCX)
